answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: an agent earns full rewards only after trading with 12 unrelated counterparties in 10 epochs. Forging 1,000 identities needs 12,000 genuine trades at 2 credits each: 24,000 credits. One honest agent pays 24, so honesty stays cheap.
